evidence_supported_interpretation: The adaptation remained safe and occasionally acquired faster, but it did not provide competitive cutter-tip regulation.
The negative paired interval and zero positive-pair fraction show a systematic position deficit rather than sampling noise.
The equivalent single-direction payload state cannot represent all internal five-link modes; this is a plausible adaptation limitation, not a proven defect in the original paper controller.
Restricting the paper method to the common acceleration interface omitted its original body-torque inner loop, preserving fairness but reducing reproduction fidelity.
forbidden_inference: These results do not evaluate or refute the original Kang and Shan controller on its published point-payload plant or hardware.
